title: Clean up repository
description: Frees disk space that Git objects, old backups and logs take up. Nothing here runs on its own.

now.heading: Now
now.shared_one: Affects the repository and its worktree.
now.shared_other: Affects the repository and all {{count}} worktrees.

normal.label: Normal
normal.frees: Frees: packs loose objects, removes unreachable objects older than two weeks and old reflog entries by Git’s defaults (90 days, 30 days for unreachable ones), packs refs.

thorough.label: Thorough
thorough.frees: Frees in addition: repacks everything with better compression and removes unreachable objects right away.
thorough.warning: Can take a long time on large repositories (minutes to hours) and needs extra space for a while.

lfs.label: Clean up the Git LFS cache
lfs.frees: Frees: local LFS files that neither the current state, the recent refs nor unpushed commits need.
lfs.estimating: Asking Git LFS what it would remove …
lfs.estimateFailed: Git LFS couldn’t say how much it would free.

worktrees.label: Orphaned worktrees
worktrees.frees: Frees: the records of worktrees whose folder is missing; their branches can be checked out again afterwards.

undo.label: Old Forkyard undo backups
undo.frees: Frees: objects that only these backups keep alive (discarded changes, old states). Backups without an undo entry are included.
undo.warning: Undo is no longer possible for these actions afterwards.

reflog.label: Shorten the reflog
reflog.frees: Frees: reflog entries older than 90 days for all refs, even if the repository sets longer periods (gc.reflogExpire). Without such a setting, Normal already does this.
reflog.warning: Commits that are only in the reflog are lost for good afterwards – also in the reflog view.

progress.waiting: Waiting for other actions in this repository …
progress.hint: You can close this dialog; the clean-up goes on and shows up in the status bar.
progress.label: Clean-up running

result.failed: Clean-up stopped at a failed step.
result.cancelled: Clean-up cancelled. Finished steps stay; the repository is valid.
result.cancelledEarly: Clean-up cancelled before it started. Nothing was changed.

failure.gcRunning: Git is already cleaning up this repository (process {{pid}}). Try again later.
failure.diskFull: No space left on the disk. The repository is still valid; free up space and try again.
